description:
Music to Release Tension | Indian Classical | 1.5 Hours

If your shoulders are up around your ears and your jaw is tight — start here. The day's stress doesn't just sit in your head; it settles into the body and holds on.

Ninety minutes of slow, deep Indian classical strings to let that tension go — soft enough to feel your shoulders drop, your jaw unclench, and your breath slow down.

What you'll hear: deep, resonant veena with long sustained notes over a gentle drone — warm and unhurried, the feeling of the body finally putting down the weight it has been carrying.

Best for: unwinding after a long day · easing physical tension · before bed or a warm bath · a quiet room and a pair of headphones.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to release tension, calm the body, and let the day go.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold patterned border. Calm evening palette — warm, soft, low amber light, settled and unhurried. Central figure: a musician with a veena, body language reading subtle HELD tension easing into release (shoulders carrying the day, on the verge of softening) — relatable recognition of 'too tense', with the warm light promising relief. IMPORTANT: vary the interior composition from the channel's other Veena/calm thumbnails so it is visually distinct in-feed. Overlay text 'TOO TENSE?' in dark-teal serif, large and mobile-readable (2 words, scans under 1 second). This is a Q-hook (banked A/B evidence: relaxation/tension lane FAVORS Q-hooks; YT promotes them for CTR). Mobile-first: minimal clutter.
suno_prompt_A: Intimate live acoustic recording of a solo veena, master Indian classical player, opens immediately with a warm captivating melodic phrase from the very first second (no slow fade-in, no long intro), real wooden instrument close-miked with natural string resonance, deeply emotive and soothing, expressive rising and falling phrases with long singing sustained notes, soft meend glides and gentle swells, soft tanpura drone, no tabla, warm full-bodied woody tone, present and flowing, healing and tender, like the body softening and letting go of held tension, seamless loopable, no vocals, no humming, no human voice
suno_prompt_B: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming, soulful solo Saraswati veena, master Indian classical performance, deep resonant gourd-bodied string with buzzing jawari resonance and sliding gamaka ornaments, rich warm full-bodied tone, emotional and moving, phrases that rise and fall with soulful swells and gentle release, long singing sustained notes, soft tanpura drone, no tabla, Raga Bhairavi, present and flowing not draggy, healing and tender, seamless loopable

production_spec.notes: Veena = bowed?? NO — plucked Saraswati veena. NO tabla. Theta 6Hz = deep let-go, not sleep.
